'''Special Investigator''' was a title given to members of the [[Special Investigations squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. Both [[Zeck Tambell]] and [[Valon Rizz]] held the title, but held the ranks of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] respectively.
